title: Attentional dynamics explain the elusive nature of context effects.
title_zh: 注意力动态解释情境效应的难以捉摸性
abstract: Context effects in multialternative, multiattribute choice are pervasive and yet, paradoxically, elusive at the same time. For example, simple changes to the spatial layout of alternatives on the screen can nullify or reverse the effects. Despite the success of dynamic decision models in explaining the occurrence of context effects, a coherent theory for understanding their elusiveness is currently lacking. We introduce a novel theoretical framework that relies on attention-modulated comparisons to explain the elusive nature of context effects. We show through simulation that our model produces the attraction, compromise, and similarity effects simply by assuming that more time is spent comparing alternatives that are more similar. However, when more time is spent comparing dissimilar alternatives, model simulations reveal a reversal of the attraction and compromise effects. The empirical support for this model-based prediction is assessed by manipulating similarity-based attention in separate experiments for the three context effects (total N = 887). Further, by allowing the spatial organization of information to constrain the attention process, the model can explain changes in context effects induced by display layout. We show that the model's spatial attention mechanism allows it to capture presentation order effects in a reanalysis of previously published data. Finally, we develop a continuous approximation of the full model that permits fitting of choices and response times. In summary, the proposed framework provides a new tool for understanding not only the existence of context effects in choice, but also the attentional factors that lead to null or reversed context effects. abstract_zh: 情境效应在多选项、多属性决策中普遍存在，却又矛盾地难以捉摸。例如，对屏幕上选项的空间布局进行简单调整，可能会消除或逆转这些效应。尽管动态决策模型已成功解释情境效应的出现，但目前尚缺乏一个连贯的理论来阐明其难以捉摸的本质。我们提出一种新颖的理论框架，基于注意力调节的比较来解释情境效应的难以捉摸性。通过仿真，我们展示了该模型仅通过假设在比较更相似的选项时花费更多时间，即可产生吸引、妥协和相似性效应。然而，当在比较不相似的选项时花费更多时间时，模型仿真显示吸引和妥协效应会出现逆转。通过在独立实验中操纵基于相似性的注意力来评估该模型预测的经验支持（总样本量 N = 887）。此外，允许信息的空间组织约束注意力过程后，模型能够解释由显示布局引起的情境效应变化。我们证明，模型的空间注意力机制能够在对先前公开数据的再分析中捕捉呈现顺序效应。最后，我们开发了该完整模型的连续近似，使其能够拟合选择和反应时间。总之，所提出的框架为理解选择中情境效应的存在以及导致其消失或逆转的注意力因素提供了新的工具。（PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved）
